name: tokeven
stderr:
tokeven-mcp: this server provides pre-send ESTIMATES only — it does not track usage. Calls made through MCP are not recorded and will not appear on your Tokeven dashboard. Usage is recorded by the Python SDK wrapper (`from tokeven import wrap`) or the local sidecar (`tokeven-proxy`). Run `tokeven status` to see what is being tracked on this machine right now.
The 'mcp' package is required to run the Tokeven MCP server.
Install it with:  pip install tokeven[mcp]
